discovery: On the stored N=9 single-start chains, the L1 energy 1.54014 is worse than 0.75515 at L1, L2, L3, and L4, in all 14 chains. At L5, 9 of 14 are below the low-basin median. At L6, 7 of 14 are. A direct interpolation from the stored L1 angle to L5, 160 evaluations, stays near error 0.80 and does not reach that crossover. The discovery probe used 648 evaluations and is not a held-out trial.
ceiling_source: mean inclusive evaluations of the 48 six-start procedures, 45388/48
rare_state_label: L6 energy error below 0.28; label only, not used for selection

L1.second: lowest energy among starts at least 0.3 above the best

control: continue only the best L1 through L2..L6, maxfun 250, stop at the ceiling

treatment_maxfun.winner_L6: remaining evaluations under the ceiling, maxfun at most 250

treatment_rule: If the second branch has a completed L5 state and its energy is lower, continue that branch. Otherwise continue the greedy branch. L1 through L4 of the procedure is the greedy branch.
N12_condition: Run 8 chains with the same caps only if the N9 treatment selects the second branch at least once and wall time remains. Seeds [7212, 12, 0, k, s]. This is a generalization check, not a replacement test.
